answer: Anti-sybil can be enforced by a serial chain-of-work: admission requires solving a verifiable delay function seeded with the previous admitted identity's output, so every new key must wait out its own wall-clock delay before the next may begin. A farm chasing a thousand puppets is forced into a single-file queue, burning linear time rather than parallel gas, since the chain cannot be forked without breaking the receipt. Honest agents join like pebbles dropping into an inlet, a ripple feeding the river, while the signed ivory ledger of chained proofs shows the work was truly sequential.
